notes.title: New IEH2 Playtest [ver. 0.3.0.0] Re-Launch!
notes.content:
We would like to thank you all for enjoying IEH as always! We have released IEH2 Playtest [ver. 0.3.0.0].
Please bear in mind that this new version will reset your progress, as we have made many changes to the balance of various systems and added some new content as well! We are looking forward to hearing all your feedback during this next playtest round!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1956700/view/3324233322408357930]See the Patch Notes[/url]

As we announced previously, we decided to change the release date to be [b]July 22nd[/b]. 
Today, our original release date, we will start the new IEH2 Playtest! We have put together some appreciation gifts for the participants of new playtest.


[h3]Playtest/IEH1 Players Appreciations Gifts[/h3]

[b]GOING OUT JUNE 10TH: New Playtest ver. 0.3.0.0[/b]
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[/i]
    - 3000 Nitro
    - IEH2 DLC Premium Nitro Pack (Use Bonus Code [DLCNitro] to unlock! This is Playtest version only)

[b]GOING OUT JULY 22ND: Early Access Release Day![/b]
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[/i]
    - 3000 Nitro
    - 1000 Epic Coin
[i]If you participated in the IEH2 Playtest regardless of date:[/i]
    - Portal Orbs (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest)
    - [Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest] x 100 Epic Coin
[i]If you’re a returning IEH1 Player[/i]
    - Special Talismans (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in IEH1. Talismans are extra boosts of stats in game.)
[i]If you’re a returning IEH1 Player who purchased the DLC [IEH2 Support Pack][/i]
   - 5500 Epic Coin
   - Accepted Quest Limit + 1

<<The gifts are subject to change>>

So, if you have participated in the playtest prior to this update, you will get 3000 Nitro at start and free DLC Premium Nitro Pack that enables to change nitro speed from x2 to x3! Keep in mind that this free DLC is only during the Playtest and will not transfer to the release version of the game.
For everyone who participates in the new playtest, you can get Steam Achievements and will be rewarded according to how many you can acquire at real release on July 22nd!
We’ve still got quite a lot of incredible content planned before release! Stay tuned and in the meantime thank you for playing our game! 😄


[b]CAUTION[/b]
- Keep in mind that the save file of this Playtest will NOT be available in the official launch.
- All the contents, features and balances in the game are subject to change. 
- In-app purchase in this Playtest is not available.

notes.title: UPDATE : The new release date is July 22nd!
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Hitan from Hapiwaku the development team of Incremental Epic Hero!
Last month, we released the Playtest of Incremental Epic Hero 2.
We are tremendously grateful for all of your feedback, as more people participated in our playtest than we originally anticipated, you have helped us to make many positive changes to the game. Thank you so much for your help with that. However, our original timetable for completing certain objectives has, as a result, been delayed, and there are several more features and mechanics that we feel must be present in the game before we release it to early access.
This means that our original release date of June 10th is no longer feasible. 

[h3]Official Launch on July 22nd and New Playtest Launch on June 10th![/h3]
Then we have determined the new release date on [b]July 22nd.[/b] 
We will also start the new IEH2 Playtest on June 10th! At that time, we will wipe the saves of IEH2 Playtest since we've added a lot of content and changed the balance around even for early game. We are really grateful for everyone participating in the IEH2 Playtest. I'm sorry that we need to reset the saves, so much has changed that in order to get the quality of feedback we need for further balancing, this is an unfortunate, but necessary, course of action. However, we’ll be distributing appreciation gifts in the June 10th patch for you all, as our way of saying thank you for participating and helping us make this game great! 

[h3]Playtest/IEH1 Players Appreciations Gifts[/h3]
[b]At the new Playtest ver. 0.3.0.0 launch on June 10th[/b]

- For participants of IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[list]
[*]3000 Nitro
[*]Enables to switch nitro speed from x2 to x3[/list]

[b]At the official launch on July 22nd[/b]
- For participants of IEH2 Playtest before June 10th:[list]
[*]3000 Nitro
[*]Some amount of Epic Coin[/list]
- For participants of IEH2 Playtest regardless date:[list]
[*]Portal Orbs (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in Playtest)
[*]Some amount of Epic Coin [/list]
- For IEH1 Players:[list]
[*] Special Talismans  (The amount is determined by Steam Achievement # you get in IEH1. Talismans are extra boosts of stats in game.)[/list]

[u]Caution : The gifts are subject to change
[/u]

So, if you already joined in IEH2 Playtest before June 10th, you will be able to play the new playtest from June 10th with super speed nitro (x3 speed, not x2). You will also get the starting boost with 3000 nitro on both new playtest and real launch! In addition, we will implement Steam Achievement in the new playtest, that will be the same as in the real launch. According to the number that you get the achievements, you will get the starting boost of Portal Orbs at the real launch too! (Portal Orbs are the limited items that you can get several amount per day from daily quests, and are used for entering dungeons, that is one of the greatest way to level heroes.)
Again, we are really appreciate to you all for giving us wonderful feedback! We will keep developing the game and improve more and more with you all 😄
Thank you for continued supports!

To get more information, why not join our [url=https://discord.gg/VqbS4Wa]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Incremental Epic Hero 2 Playtest
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Hitan from the Hapiwaku IEH development team.
[b]Today, we are pleased to announce a Playtest of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690710/Incremental_Epic_Hero_2/]Incremental Epic Hero 2[/url]![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690710/Incremental_Epic_Hero_2/

We are currently targeting official launch date on [b]June 10th 2022[/b]. 
Toward that goal, we will conduct a public playtest for about a month. This will help us balance the game and improve other various aspects of the game in preparation for the official release.
Please try it and post any feedback! We are very active in [url=https://discord.gg/QEpxWM2fv5]Discord Community[/url] and open to hear your voice to improve the game and make it more fun! Even if you've never played IEH1, you will still enjoy IEH2 🙂

[h3]New Features[/h3]
Though there are a lot of new features in IEH2, let me introduce some of them:
[list]
[*] In addition to the original 3 characters, Warrior/Wizard/Angel, 3 new characters are in IEH2! Thief, Archer and Tamer.
[*] A whole new prestige system for each class and the whole world!
[*] A Town building system that allows you to boost upgrades, unlock new areas, and other parts of the game.
[*] Chat feature in the game that makes gameplay more enjoyable!
[*] New graphics with full HD widescreen and super optimized game performance!
[/list]

[h3]A Completely New Game Compared to IEH1[/h3]
When we first announced about IEH2 in IEH1 page just a year ago, IEH2 was going to be just a remaster of IEH1, but over the past year, IEH2 has become a completely new game compared to IEH1! After several alpha and beta tests, and thanks to our test team and players in Discord, the game has taken an amazing leap forward over the past year.
With only about a month left until this official launch, we would love to have your help to make even more strides. Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/QEpxWM2fv5]Discord Community[/url] and post your great feedback 🙂
Also, please don't forget to add this game to your wishlist so that you don't miss the official release!

[h3]CAUTION[/h3]
- Keep in mind that the save file of this Playtest will NOT be available in the official launch.
- All the contents, features and balances in the game are subject to change. 
- In-app purchase in this Playtest is not available. 


[i]A Message from Dev. Morkyl[/i]
Hi everyone! I'm Morkyl, one of the game designers, here to express our gratitude for any feedback you can offer and to let you know that we are still hard at work designing even more to do and sculpting the game based very much on the feedback we receive.


[i]A Message from Dev. Kei About IEH1[/i]
Hello everyone, thanks for enjoying Incremental Epic Hero on a regular basis! I also apologize for the delay in reporting the progress of the update. I'm currently spending time creating an internal library codings and securing human resources to work on it so that we can update it more efficiently.
The next update is scheduled for around August of this year. Also, we will be doing some collaborative updates with IEH2, so stay tuned!

notes.title: [ver. 1.4.8.0] Added : Expedition & Artifact, IEH finally became an IDLE game!
notes.content:
[b][ver. 1.4.8.0] Added : Expedition & Artifact![/b]

Added : Expedition 
- You can unlock Expedition and expand Expedition slots through completing a quest.
- After spending hours you selected, you will gain three kind of chests that include an Artifact or some materials for Artifacts.

Added : Artifact
- Artifacts have an unique effect and sometimes additional effects.
- Artifacts grow through spending time up to its max level.
- You can raise the max level by using some materials from chests.
- You can expand Artifact Slot and Inventory Slot with Reincarnation upgrades.
- Anti-magic Power now has no effect but will be an important factor for the future update Hidden-Challenge.

Added : Time Warps in Epic Store

Balanced : Offline Bonus now includes expedition progress and artifact growth
Balanced : Increased Nitro Gain during offline from "1 nitro / 8 sec" to "1 nitro / 4 sec"
Fixed : Display bug



[i]Message from Developer Kei[/i]
Hello, everyone. First of all, sorry for the long delay in updating.
In this update, there are some major changes to the system and the save system for continuous updates in the future . (As a result, the file size of the save data for the next update may become very large). As a result, various bugs have arisen and we are taking time to fix them. We apologize to everyone for the long wait.

I also want to let you know about the development of IEH2, which has already started, but rather than being a sequel to IEH1, it has been decided that it will be a game with completely new content (although the basic combat system will be the same). Therefore, IEH1 will continue to be updated continuously as well.

There are a couple of things that concern me about this update. First, a major system modification is changing the save system. It will not affect gameplay, but the size of the save file has been increased. There may also be some potential bugs caused by this. However, this is also necessary for us to keep this game updated for a long time, so we hope you understand.

About Future Update, 
We will be adding more powerful challenge bosses as future updates. Like Curse Reincarnation, there will be restrictions on various stats. Also, higher tier stats will be available and you can enhance them with artifacts. Anti Magic Power will become very important in the next challenge boss.

Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Happy 1st Anniversary! Today is IEH's first anniversary!
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Hitan from Hapiwaku IEH development team! 
Thank you for playing IEH and for all your comments!

[h2]The First Anniversary![/h2]
[b]Today, April 15, 2021 is the first anniversary of Incremental Epic Hero!
[/b]We first released the alpha version on January 2020. A lot of people found our game and gave us feedback and made a lot of discussion. Then we improved it and officially released IEH on [url=https://www.kongregate.com/games/hapiwakuproject/incremental-epic-hero]Kongregate[/url] just a year ago, April 15, 2020. We won the 4th place in Kongregate Monthly Contest of April 2020. After a while, we achieved one million plays on Kongregate. We continued to improve IEH step by step, thanks to your all support. After releasing it on [url=https://armorgames.com/incremental-epic-hero-game/19011]Armorgames[/url] and [url=https://www.crazygames.com/game/incremental-epic-hero]Crazygames[/url], we finally released it on Steam on February 2021, that was our immediate goal. Then we are pleased to welcome the first anniversary today! We are so happy and grateful to see more and more people enjoy our game. The number of the members in [url=https://discord.gg/kJqBrZfuy4]our Discord server[/url] is currently more than 2200, still increasing! Thank you again for your support!


[h2]IEH Road Map[/h2]
IEH will keep growing in the future too. We are pleased to announce the roadmap for IEH at this time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806146/53123030c5a0c06b3cff3c55af3049113d9aa73b.png[/img]

As we previously announced, we started to develop IEH2, that is a sequel to the current IEH. 
This time we announce that[b] IEH mobile version (iOS & Android) launch has been decided! [/b]
We will tell you the detail of it in the near future!


[h2]New Illustrations from Hapiwaku Artwork Team![/h2]
Also, to celebrate the 1st anniversary, we posted new illustrations from Hapiwaku artwork team! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806146/77b6a09e75e593c6310394aa21435a5259864336.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806146/ab9383ade7a59c9c3cd81d4523b5c4ccffb7d4d0.png[/img]


[h2]DLC Complete Bundle[/h2]

In addition, we prepared the [b]DLC Complete Bundle[/b] on Steam, that you can buy all of the DLCs with 10% off. Please try it at this opportunity!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20687/Complete_Bundle/


I have been very busy last year because I was also a graduate school student and I had to work in physics research. I just graduated this spring and became to be able to concentrate on IEH development! I'd love to communicate you all more often. We need you! Let us improve IEH more and more fun together!!!
Thank you!

notes.title: We have released a new DLC "IEH2 Support Pack"!
notes.content:
Hi, this is Hitan, one of the developers of IEH! Thank you as always for playing IEH and for all your comments!
We have released a new DLC "IEH2 Support Pack"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580930/Incremental_Epic_Hero__IEH2_Support_Pack/

The contents of this DLC are as follows:

[b]- Upgrades almost all the monsters' art to IEH2's.
- Upgrades the character icon in the battle screen to IEH2's.
- 5500 Epic Coin
- Supports the developers to make IEH2.[/b]

This DLC allows you to pre-warp into parts of the IEH2 world!


[h3]Incremental Epic Hero 2 Development[/h3]
As we mentioned in the previous post, we are currently working on Incremental Epic Hero 2 (IEH2), which is much upgraded from the current IEH (IEH1). 
We plan to release IEH2 as a new game that is a sequel to IEH1 in the near future! 
IEH2 is a kind of Prestige Tier 3 after Reincarnation. You can take over some parts of the save data of IEH1 to IEH2 and you will gain various reward in IEH2 according to your progress of IEH1!

[b]New Features in IEH2[/b]
- Three New Classes! [i]Thief, Archer and Tamer![/i]
- New Characteristic Monsters! [i]Flame Tiger, Treant, Unicorn and so on![/i]
- World Map System! [i]Expanding vast explorable areas![/i]
- Five Main Attribute Attack! [i]Fire, Ice, Thunder, Light and Dark![/i]
- Prestige Tier 3! [i]Powerful upgrades and changing the world![/i]
- Treasure System! [i]More and more rewarded in area progress![/i]
- Expedition and Artifact! [i]Improving idling feature![/i]
- New Graphics and Game Performance! [i]Full HD wide screen![/i]
and so on...


We, [i]Hapiwaku Project Team[/i], are still very small development team. Kei, a friend of mine, and I are main developers, who are 24 years old and just graduated from graduate school this spring. I previously planned to go on to a doctoral course, but I decided to concentrate on IEH development! My 19-years-older wife, Wakana, is pregnant and the baby is due in this June. She is working on the new world map of IEH2 with the baby. My 13-year-old daughter, Arua, is also working for various artwork of IEH2, and my sister, Nohn, is supporting them. We family are encouraged by all your comment and very active to develop IEH with [i]hapiwaku ![/i] ([i]Hapiwaku[/i] is a Japanese word that means happy and excited.) A lot of new features are coming in IEH2! We will continue to work on improving our game. We will also keep updating IEH1 based on your wonderful feedback, so please keep up the good work and looking forward to the future updates!

notes.title: About IEH&IEB Collaboration Event / IEH Future Updates
notes.content:
Hi, this is [b]Hitan[/b], one of the developers of Hapiwaku Project Team :)

For IEH & IEB collaboration event that is launched after [ver. 1.4.4.0], it is planned to keep permanently, so the bonus effects are permanently available. You can freely play both the games anytime :)

This time, I will let you know the development stance for IEH and IEB.
Kei and I (Hitan) are mainly responsible for IEH, while Suguru and Koga are mainly responsible for IEB. All of them are the members of Hapiwaku Project Team. 
Each developer team keeps developing each game, so neither the games' development are stopped and slowed.
IEH developer team is currently working for [b]IEH2[/b] that is much upgraded from the current IEH. IEH2 is something like the new phase of ascension tier 3. We will soon have some announcement about the detail of IEH2 :D
While, IEB developer team is still beginners to develop idle games. They are trying hard to improve IEB much more. Please give us any feedback in IEB community and support to improve it together :)

By the way, I will graduate from graduate school this spring. Though I previously planned to go on to a doctoral course, I decided to concentrate on IEH development. It's a personal matter but my wife is pregnant and the baby is due in this June. I'll do my best for my family and for you all to enjoy our game and feel [i]hapiwaku[/i] much more! ([i]Hapiwaku[/i] is a Japanese word that means happy and excited!) My 13-year-old daughter is also working for the new class artwork for IEH2. My wife with our baby is drawing the new world map for IEH2 too. All of us are very active to develop our game with [i]hapiwaku![/i]
Anyway thank you as always for supporting us a lot! Please look forward to the future updates! :D

Let's join our Discord Community and chat with us!
